<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Central Core''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：中央コア</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋１できる上に、デス・スターのトラクター・ビームをキャンセルできる。ダークサイド：ここを支配したなら、「行き止まり」と「橋脚を収納せよ」は、コスト０で配備する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-283o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Central Core.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: If you control, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam is canceled. Dark Side: If you control, 行き止まり and 橋脚を収納せよ deploy for 0.

'''Lore:''' 

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Dark Side names 行き止まり and 橋脚を収納せよ for Wrong Turn and Retract The Bridge.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Central Core]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
